deficiencies.description: The text uses deictic pointing words ("the tumor is here", "This is the outer surface of the uterus") without specifying their spatial relationship. The rewrite converts these pointing words into a description not given in the text by stating that "The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus".
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The text uses the word "circumspect", whereas the rewrite changes this to the technical term "circumscribed", which is a changed term not provided in the corrections list.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.reason: The phrase 'in a sense' faithfully preserves the hedge expressed by 'if you like'.

considerations.sourcePassage: so it might be difficult to necessarily find all of the possible secondary tumors unless there is some other physical sign that you can detect.
considerations.reason: Using 'therefore' to represent the lecturer's 'so' accurately conveys the consequential link expressed in the original text.
